crossRefs.note: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown…
Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet, who said to him, “Why have you sought…
As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be…
to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.
Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

translations.web: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
translations.bsb: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders; instead, he consulted the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
translations.kjv: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
translations.asv: But he forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men that were grown up with him, that stood before him.
